text: dsh-mcp-jetbrains 是面向 DSH Web 的 JetBrains IDE MCP 连接插件，可把 IntelliJ IDEA、CLion、PyCharm 等 IDE 内置的 MCP Server 接入 DSH。它为每条连接挂载独立 MCP 客户端，将 IDE 工具注册到 DSH，并在 Web 设置页管理连接、查看健康状态和手动重连。启用“读写走 IDE”后，文件读取、写入和编辑可交给所选 IDE 处理；插件也会探测连接状态，在工具调用失败时进行诊断并按条件重试。适合希望让 DSH agent 使用 IDE 项目视图和 MCP 工具的用户；需要自行配置 IDE MCP 地址。

dsh-mcp-jetbrains connects JetBrains IDE MCP servers to DSH Web. It mounts one client per configured IDE and exposes its tools. A Web page manages connections and health. With file I/O through IDE enabled, read, write, and edit calls use the selected IDE. Configure an IDE MCP endpoint to connect.
想把 JetBrains IDE 里提供的 MCP 工具接到 DSH 里使用。
让 DSH 通过 IntelliJ、PyCharm 或 CLion 的项目上下文处理文件。
Connect several JetBrains IDE MCP servers to DSH and manage them from its Web settings.
dsh-mcp-jetbrains 的功能「IDE 连接管理」：在 Web 设置页维护多条 JetBrains IDE MCP 连接，每条连接挂载独立客户端并暴露对应工具；可查看连接状态、保存配置后重挂或手动重连。
dsh-mcp-jetbrains 的功能「经 IDE 读写文件」：启用设置开关后，将 DSH 的 read、write、edit 工具请求路由到匹配的 IDE 连接，并把无法处理的情况作为明确错误返回。

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · dsh-mcp-jetbrains：中文 | [English](README.en.md) · [安全](SAFETY.md) · [路线规划](文档/软件工程/0.项目管理/路线规划.md)

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：把 JetBrains IDE 内置的 MCP Server 接成 DSH 的工具，让智能体直接用 IDE 的能力——诊断、构建、读文件、数据库、终端、调试。

DSH 侧只做连接管理器，**不往 IDE 里装任何东西**：IDE 自 2025.2 起内置 `MCP Server` 插件并默认启用。名字里带 jetbrains 而不是 idea，因为它同样连 CLion、PyCharm。

> **先读[安全说明](SAFETY.md)。** 接了 IDE 的 MCP，等于把 IDE 能做的事交给了模型，其中包括执行终端命令与操作数据库。

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 为什么做：同一个项目里存在两份互相不认账的真相：

| | 看什么 |
|---|---|
| IDE | 内存缓冲区 + 自己的 inspection 引擎 |
| DSH | 磁盘上的字节 |

于是会出现「IDE 报错而 DSH 查完说没异常」，以及「IDE 重启后工具还在列表里，但每次调用都报 session not found」。

据此定的**第一原则**：

> **读不到 ≠ 没问题。** 取不到 IDE 结论时必须显式报「未知/不可用」，不得降级成「检查通过」。

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 提供什么：| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 多 IDE 连接管理 | 每条连接挂一个 MCP 客户端子插件；配置存在插件自有存储，不写 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，改完不用重启 DSH |
| 健康探测 | 后台定期探测，区分「TCP 连不上（IDE 没开）」与「会话 404 / 工具面变了（失效）」 |
| 自动重连 | 发现失效后只重挂受影响的那一条连接，其它连接与配置不动 |
| 调用失败的自诊断 | 失败后先取服务端工具清单，判断是「工具名问题」还是「连接问题」；只有传输类失败才就地重挂并**重试一次** |
| 读写走 IDE | 一个开关，强制把 `read` / `write` / `edit` 交给 IDE 执行，路由不到就失败而非落盘 |
| 诊断面板 | Host 保留最近 50 条自动动作，设置页显示前 5 条，能回答「它为什么自己重连了」 |

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 安装：前提：IDE 2025.2+（内置 MCP Server，默认启用），且 IDE 侧 MCP Server 可访问。

**从 npm 安装**（推荐）：

```text
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-jetbrains
```

装完重启 DSH（`dsh web`），再进 **设置 → JetBrains IDE 连接**。

**从仓库源码安装**（开发用，linked）：

```text
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<本仓库根目录>
```

`dsh plugin` 把参数原样转给该 profile 目录里的 pnpm，所以 `remove`、`why` 等子命令同样可用。改源码后需要重装才生效（linked 插件不热更新）。

连接配置存在：

```text
$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-mcp-jetbrains.connections.json
```
dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 安装：结构为 `{ version: 1, ideIo: { enabled }, connections: [...] }`。若存在旧插件（`@local/dsh-mcp-idea`）留下的 `dsh-mcp-idea.connections.json`，首次启动会自动迁移，**旧文件保留以便回滚**。

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 配置一条连接：| 字段 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| 连接 ID | 只用于日志与诊断，界面上认这一行，同一份配置里不能重复 |
| 服务名 `serverName` | 工具名前缀，形如 `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$`；工具以 `mcp__<serverName>__*` 暴露，改名等于给工具改名 |
| MCP 地址 | IDE 里 MCP Server 监听地址，DSH 以 `streamable-http` 连过去，例如 `http://127.0.0.1:64342/stream` |
| 项目路径 | 可选。作为 `U_MCP_SERVER_PROJECT_PATH` 请求头发给 IDE，留空则由 IDE 自己挑项目 |
| 启用 / 自动重载 | 分别控制是否挂载、是否允许后台自动重连 |

端口**没有公式**：本机实测 IDEA 64342、CLion 64362、PyCharm 64462，各 IDE 各自配置，请以 IDE 显示为准。

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 路由模式 vs 全量模式（必读）：IDE 的 MCP Server 有一个「工具暴露」开关。**仅路由模式**下，`tools/list` 只返回 1 个工具 `execute_tool`，其余全部藏在它后面，参数是字符串形式的 `--name value`，不是结构化 JSON：

```text
mcp__idea__execute_tool  →  get_file_problems --filePath src/main.ts
```

本机实测该模式下 IDE 实际有 66 个工具。**这是连接建立时的快照**：切换模式后必须重新连接才能看到新工具面。
section: 路由模式 vs 全量模式（必读）

text:
dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 读写走 IDE：设置页顶部的开关，存 `ideIo.enabled`（**默认开**）。开启后插件在工具调用层拦截 `read` / `write` / `edit`，改走 IDE 的 `read_file` / `create_new_file` / `apply_patch`。

路由规则：把目标文件绝对路径与各已启用连接的 `projectPath` 做**最长前缀匹配**；并列即失败；无匹配但恰好只有一条启用连接则用它（诊断里记 `fallback: true`）。

**核心语义：无法路由时明确失败，绝不静默回落磁盘。** 报错会给出三种解法——关掉开关 / 启用一条覆盖该文件的连接 / 修正 `projectPath`。

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 还没有任何连接时：开关可以开着，插件不会因此拒绝工作，但也不会替你做决定。第一次 `read` / `write` / `edit` 会**先向你提问**：

| 选项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 粘贴 JetBrains 配置 | 把 IDE「复制配置」的 JSON 填进自定义回答，插件自动建一条连接并**用同一次调用重试** |
| 让这次不代执行 | 插件**不写任何东西**，并明确告诉模型：要读写磁盘就自己走 shell，或先启用连接再重试 |
| 取消本次操作 | 什么都不做 |

第二条是刻意的：成功结果里的附加说明会被框架丢弃，若插件替你写了磁盘，模型会误以为数据来自 IDE——**这正是本项目要消灭的那种错觉**。多一轮对话，换掉一次静默的认知错误。

`edit` 不整读文件：先用 `search_text` 定位，再用 `apply_patch` 应用，有预算上限（上下文 3 行、候选上限 10、单次累计读取 200 行、patch 最多 2 次）。

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 已知限制与边界：| 限制 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| shell 删除不受约束 | 「读写走 IDE」只拦工具层的 `read`/`write`/`edit`。模型若用 `Remove-Item` / `rm` 删除，IDE 不知情，Local History 也救不了 |
| 终端与 SQL 不受该开关约束 | IDE 的 `execute_terminal_command`、`execute_sql_query` 照常可用，不受路由策略影响 |
| 写入的 EOL 由 IDE 决定 | 实测本机经 IDE 写入得到 **CRLF**，而 DSH 原生写入是 LF |
| 读到的是 IDE 缓冲区 | 文件在 IDE 里打开且有未保存修改时，读到的是缓冲区内容（实测 640 行 vs 磁盘 763 行） |
| `apply_patch` 不查歧义 | 多处相同文本时它**静默修改第一处**并报成功（实测确认）。因此 `edit` 必须先搜索定位 |
| 文档与本机实现不一致 | 官方文档写 `read_file` 用 `mode`/`start_line`；本机 2026.2.3 实际是 `(file_path, offset, limit)` |
| `apply_patch` 批量非原子 | 合法操作照做、非法操作逐条报错、**不回滚**：`1 out of 2 operations applied` |
| `write` 内部仍读一次 | 为生成原生 `before`，内部读 offset 1 / limit 5000；>5000 行的文件会带截断标记 |

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 构建：源码是 TypeScript / TSX，`tsc` 1:1 编译，**不打包**：

```text
pnpm build      # tsc -p tsconfig.host.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json
```

| 源码 | 产物 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | `lib/index.js` | Host 半，Node ESM，允许裸 `import` |
| `src/client.tsx` | `client.js` | 客户端半（设置页），**产物里不许出现任何 `import`** |

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 构建：Host 与客户端用两份配置分别编译（`tsconfig.host.json` / `tsconfig.client.json`），共用 `tsconfig.json` 里的编译选项：宿主产物进 `lib/`，客户端产物留在根——这是 DSH 插件的通行布局。静态资源放 `assets/`（`icon.svg`）；`locale/*.json` 必须留在根，DSH 既按目录约定读它、也要求它出现在 `exports` 里。

JSX 用经典运行时（`jsx: "react"` + `jsxFactory: "h"`）：浏览器侧是裸 ESM 工厂脚本，解析不了 `react/jsx-runtime`。

`@deepseek-ai/*` 是 peer 依赖，工程内没有 node_modules 供解析，类型由 `src/env.d.ts` 的模块 shim 顶上。
dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 构建：`pnpm-lock.yaml` **不入库**：本目录 `pnpm install` 会因上游尚未发布的包而 404，lock 无法再生成/校验；`pnpm-workspace.yaml` 里因此关了 `verifyDepsBeforeRun`。

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 兼容性：| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| IDE | 2025.2+ 内置 MCP Server（默认启用） |
| 本机实测 | **2026.2.3（IU-262.10968.63）**，`since-build = 262` |
| DSH 侧传输 | `stdio`、`streamable-http`（**不支持 SSE**） |
| 向下兼容 | 未测试，交社区反馈 |
dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · 路线：技术判断、实测记录与后续计划在[路线规划](文档/软件工程/0.项目管理/路线规划.md)，按主题分节记录了「为什么是这样做」以及踩过的坑。下一轮计划把删除、移动、符号改名也接到 IDE（`apply_patch` 的 Delete / move-to 与 `rename_refactoring`）。

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · dsh-mcp-jetbrains：[中文](README.md) | English · [Safety](SAFETY.en.md) · [Roadmap](文档/软件工程/0.项目管理/路线规划.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that turns the MCP Server built into JetBrains IDEs into DSH tools, so the agent can use the IDE directly: diagnostics, builds, file reads, databases, terminals, debugging.

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · dsh-mcp-jetbrains：The DSH side is only a connection manager and **installs nothing into your IDE**: since 2025.2, IntelliJ IDEA ships an `MCP Server` plugin that is enabled by default. The name says jetbrains rather than idea because it also connects CLion and PyCharm.

> **Read the [safety notes](SAFETY.en.md) first.** Wiring up the IDE's MCP hands the model everything the IDE can do — including running terminal commands and writing to databases.

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Why this exists：A single project holds two truths that never reconcile:

| | What it looks at |
|---|---|
| The IDE | The in-memory buffer plus its own inspection engine |
| DSH | Bytes on disk |

Hence "the IDE reports an error while DSH finds nothing", and "after the IDE restarts the tools are still listed, but every call fails with session not found".

The principle that follows:
dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Why this exists：> **Unable to read ≠ fine.** When the IDE's verdict cannot be obtained, say "unknown/unavailable" explicitly. Never degrade it into "check passed".

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · What it provides：| Capability | Detail |
|---|---|
| Multi-IDE connection management | One MCP client child plugin per connection; settings live in the plugin's own store, never in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, so changes need no DSH restart |
| Health probing | Background probes distinguish "TCP refused (IDE not running)" from "session 404 / tool surface changed (stale)" |
| Automatic remount | Only the affected connection is remounted; other connections and the configuration stay untouched |
| Failure self-diagnosis | On failure, fetch the server's tool list to tell "wrong tool name" from "connection problem"; only transport-class failures trigger a remount and **one** retry |
| Read/write via IDE | A switch that forces `read` / `write` / `edit` through the IDE, failing loudly instead of falling back to disk |
| Diagnostics panel | The host keeps the last 50 automatic actions; the settings page shows the first 5, answering "why did it reconnect on its own" |

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Install：Requires IDE 2025.2+ (built-in MCP Server, enabled by default) with a reachable MCP Server endpoint.

**Install from npm** (recommended):

```text
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-jetbrains
```

Restart DSH (`dsh web`) afterwards, then open **Settings → JetBrains IDE 连接**.

**Install from source** (development, linked):

```text
dsh plugin --profile web add link:<this repository root>
```

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Install：`dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm inside the profile directory, so `remove`, `why`, and friends work too. Linked plugins are not hot-reloaded: edit the sources, then reinstall.

Then open **Settings → JetBrains IDE 连接**.

Configuration lives at:

```text
$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-mcp-jetbrains.connections.json
```

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Install：Shape: `{ version: 1, ideIo: { enabled }, connections: [...] }`. If an older install (`@local/dsh-mcp-idea`) left `dsh-mcp-idea.connections.json`, it is migrated automatically on first start and **the old file is kept for rollback**.

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Configuring a connection：| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Connection ID | Used for logs and diagnostics, shown in the UI, must be unique within the config |
| `serverName` | Tool-name prefix matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$`; tools appear as `mcp__<serverName>__*`, so renaming it renames the tools |
| MCP address | Where the IDE's MCP Server listens; DSH connects with `streamable-http`, e.g. `http://127.0.0.1:64342/stream` |
| Project path | Optional. Sent as the `U_MCP_SERVER_PROJECT_PATH` header; leave empty to let the IDE choose |
| Enabled / Auto-reload | Whether to mount it, and whether background auto-reconnect is allowed |
dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Configuring a connection：Ports follow **no formula**: on our machine IDEA used 64342, CLion 64362, PyCharm 64462. Trust what the IDE shows.

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Router mode vs full mode (must read)：The IDE's MCP Server has a tool-exposure switch. In **router-only mode** `tools/list` returns a single `execute_tool`, and everything else hides behind it with string arguments of the form `--name value`, not structured JSON:

```text
mcp__idea__execute_tool  →  get_file_problems --filePath src/main.ts
```

On our machine that mode exposed 66 real tools. **This is a snapshot taken when the connection is established**: after switching modes you must reconnect to see the new tool surface.
section: Router mode vs full mode (must read)

text:
dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Read/write via IDE：A switch at the top of the settings page, stored as `ideIo.enabled` (**on by default**). When on, the plugin intercepts `read` / `write` / `edit` at the tool layer and routes them to the IDE's `read_file` / `create_new_file` / `apply_patch`.

Routing: longest-prefix match between the target file's absolute path and each enabled connection's `projectPath`; a tie fails; no match with exactly one enabled connection falls back to it (recorded as `fallback: true`).

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Read/write via IDE：**Core semantics: when it cannot route, it fails loudly and never silently writes to disk.** The error lists three remedies: turn the switch off, enable a connection covering that file, or fix its `projectPath`.

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · When there is no connection yet：The switch may stay on; the plugin neither refuses to work nor decides for you. The first `read` / `write` / `edit` **asks you**:

| Option | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Paste JetBrains config | Put the IDE's "copy config" JSON in the custom answer; the plugin creates a connection and **retries the same call** |
| Do not run it for me | The plugin writes nothing and tells the model plainly: use the shell yourself, or enable a connection and retry |
| Cancel | Nothing happens |
section: When there is no connection yet

text: dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · When there is no connection yet：The second option is deliberate: extra text on a *successful* result is dropped by the host pipeline, so if the plugin wrote to disk on your behalf the model would believe the bytes came from the IDE — exactly the confusion this project exists to remove. One extra round beats one silent misconception.
section: When there is no connection yet

text: dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · When there is no connection yet：`edit` never reads the whole file: it locates with `search_text` first, then applies with `apply_patch`, under hard budgets (3 context lines, 10 candidates, 200 lines read per call, at most 2 patch attempts).
section: When there is no connection yet

text: dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Known limitations：This section is the honest part; read it before installing. Full risk notes live in [Safety](SAFETY.en.md).

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Known limitations：| Limitation | Detail |
|---|---|
| Shell deletion is not covered | The switch only intercepts `read`/`write`/`edit`. A model running `Remove-Item` / `rm` bypasses the IDE, and Local History cannot save you |
| Terminal and SQL are not covered | The IDE's `execute_terminal_command` and `execute_sql_query` stay available regardless of routing policy |
| EOL is decided by the IDE | Writes through the IDE produced **CRLF** on our machine, while DSH writes LF |
| Reads may return the IDE buffer | If the file is open with unsaved edits, you read the buffer (measured 640 lines vs 763 on disk) |
| `apply_patch` ignores ambiguity | With repeated text it **silently patches the first match** and reports success (verified). Hence `edit` must locate first |
| Docs disagree with this build | The official docs describe `mode`/`start_line`; IDE 2026.2.3 actually takes `(file_path, offset, limit)` |
| `apply_patch` batches are not atomic | Valid operations apply, invalid ones report per-path errors, **no rollback**: `1 out of 2 operations applied` |
| `write` still reads once | To produce the native `before` it reads offset 1 / limit 5000; files over 50

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Build：Sources are TypeScript / TSX, compiled 1:1 by `tsc`, **no bundling**:

```text
pnpm build      # tsc -p tsconfig.host.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json
```

| Source | Output | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `src/index.ts` | `lib/index.js` | Host half, Node ESM, bare `import` allowed |
| `src/client.tsx` | `client.js` | Client half (settings page), **must contain no `import` at all** |

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Build：Host and client are compiled by two configs (`tsconfig.host.json` / `tsconfig.client.json`) that share the options in `tsconfig.json`: the host lands in `lib/`, the client stays at the root — the conventional layout for DSH plugins. Static assets live in `assets/` (`icon.svg`); `locale/*.json` must stay at the root, because DSH reads it by directory convention and also expects it in `exports`.

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Build：JSX uses the classic runtime (`jsx: "react"` + `jsxFactory: "h"`): the browser loads a bare ESM factory script that cannot resolve `react/jsx-runtime`.

`@deepseek-ai/*` are peer dependencies and are not resolvable inside this project; types come from module shims in `src/env.d.ts`.

`pnpm-lock.yaml` is **not committed**: `pnpm install` here hits a 404 on an unpublished upstream package, so the lock cannot be validated. `pnpm-workspace.yaml` therefore disables `verifyDepsBeforeRun`.

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Compatibility：| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| IDE | 2025.2+ built-in MCP Server (enabled by default) |
| Measured on | **2026.2.3 (IU-262.10968.63)**, `since-build = 262` |
| DSH transports | `stdio`, `streamable-http` (**no SSE**) |
| Older versions | Untested; community feedback welcome |

dsh-mcp-jetbrains README · Roadmap：Technical judgement, measurements, and plans live in the [roadmap](文档/软件工程/0.项目管理/路线规划.md). The next round wires deletion, moves, and symbol renames into the IDE (`apply_patch` Delete / move-to and `rename_refactoring`).
